mapper.sql: r.id, r.tenant_id, r.product_id, r.routing_version, r.effective_date, r.expiry_date, r.status, r.is_panel, r.panel_size, r.nodes, r.edges, r.version, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.created_by, r.updated_by, r.deleted, m.code AS product_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO routing ( id, tenant_id, product_id, routing_version, effective_date, expiry_date, status, is_panel, panel_size, nodes, edges, version, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{productId}, #{routingVersion}, #{effectiveDate}, #{expiryDate}, #{status}, #{isPanel}, #{panelSize}, #{nodes,typeHandler=com.hengce.aps.infrastructure.persistence.handler.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{edges,typeHandler=com.hengce.aps.infrastructure.persistence.handler.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{deleted} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM routing r LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id = r.product_id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = false
mapper.update: UPDATE routing SET status = #{status}, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = false
UPDATE routing SET status = 'INACTIVE', version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted = false AND id <> #{excludeId}
UPDATE routing SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = false
